title: Firms whose reviews finish faster or slower than like reviews
question: Which named firms and licensed professionals see their plan reviews finished faster, or slower, than like reviews, beyond what chance would produce?
finding: 131 firms and professionals are listed on 40 or more scored jobs. 7 are faster than like reviews beyond chance and 7 slower (cut 3.6 standard errors, so about 0.05 would pass by luck). Fastest: Comstock Crosser & Assoc Develp Co Inc. (contractor), average place 0.34 on 73 jobs, 26% of its review visits finished the day they arrived.
how: Each permit’s average place among like reviews (see the consultant screen) is credited to every named firm or professional on it; permits filed for the same lot on the same day are one job and count once. A firm’s score is the mean over its permits, set against the citywide mean with its own spread. "Same day" is the share of its station visits that finished on the arrival date.
limits: Speed has honest causes: complete drawings, simple repeat work (one sign company, one fire-alarm installer), a specialty the cells do not capture. Contractors are often added after review starts, so a contractor’s score partly reflects the architect’s drawings. A name match on the contacts table is exact on a normalised name; one firm may appear under two spellings. The code requires review in the order material is received unless a written public-policy finding says otherwise (Campaign and Governmental Conduct Code 3.400(b)); these figures cannot show whether such findings were made.
